title: Kenyan-Style Zesty Vermicelli Pasta
description: A flavorful and quick pasta dish inspired by the bold flavors of Kenya, combining zesty spices with vermicelli pasta in a harmonious blend.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the vermicelli pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Drain the pasta and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tsp of oil over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and crushed red pepper; sauté for 1-2 minutes.
Add the tagine spice mix and stir for 1 minute.
Add the zesty sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked vermicelli pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the spice sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
